comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Item 0 returns 1 when a comment explicitly refutes a specific example or anecdote the OP gave in the post body. Item 1 returns 1 when a comment opens by rejecting the OP's whole view without first acknowledging any validity. One targets a specific OP example. The other targets the overall view and is defined by its opening and the lack of a concession. Their eligibility rules and null handling also differ: item 0 returns null for missing argument, and item 1 does not.
